results.title: Notion AI Rebuilt: 24-Hour Agents, Auto, New Credits | CellCog
results.content:
1. A clock with a long arc around it.

   Notion rebuilt Notion Agent and Custom Agents on October 19, 2026, its sixth agent harness. A single task can now run for more than 24 hours, up from five minutes.
2. One path splitting into a thin lane and a thick lane.

   Its upgraded Auto router sends easy work to cheap models and hard work to capable ones. Notion says it matched Opus 5.5 and Astra on 20+ use cases at about 90% lower average cost.
3. Two coin stacks, one tall, one short.

   Business and Enterprise seats now get two monthly pools: 1,500 Standard credits when Notion picks the model and 500 Select credits when you pick it or run Custom Agents. Neither rolls over.
4. A small meter beside a large one. [...] ## § 01What changed, in one table#

| Change | Before | After |
 --- 
| Longest single agent task | Five minutes | More than 24 hours |
| Tools agents can reach | A few dozen earlier this summer | Hundreds, via MCPs and connectors |
| Model choice | Pick a model, or Auto | Upgraded Auto, about 90% lower cost on Notion’s tests |
| Custom Agent run cost | Baseline | About 30% less in Notion’s testing |
| App speed | Baseline | Up to 50% faster on web and mobile |
| Paying with outside AI | Not offered | ChatGPT Plus, Pro or Go in the personal Notion Agent; Enterprise bring-your-own-key in alpha |

Table 1Notion AI changes announced October 19, 2026 (Notion blog and help pages) [...] The router is the part that pays for the rest. Notion says Auto “delivered similar results to Opus 5.5 and Astra at about 90% lower average cost” across more than 20 common use cases, so credits go about 10 times further. Its head of AI framed the trade in a team meeting Kothari quotes: “To support long-running threads in a way that wouldn’t blow through credits, we knew we needed to pair them with significant efficiency gains.” The details are on Notion’s blog, its credits help page and its pricing page.

results.content:
Releases /

# Agents, rebuilt to do more for less

Today, Notion AI gets some major upgrades. Introducing:  
  
→ More capable Notion Agents  
→ A smarter Auto (frontier results, 90% cheaper)  
→ Bring your own AI (BYOK)  
→ Improved Notion MCP  
→ AI Command Center (coming soon)  
→ A new credit system

Uh-oh! It looks like your ad blocker is preventing the video from playing.

Please watch it on YouTube

We rebuilt our agent harness. Again.  
  
Notion Agents now have their own computer and browser, smarter context management, and a new “Review for me” mode with safety checks.  
  
They can work on tasks for up to 24 hours. And chats load up to 50% faster on mobile. [...] Meet Auto, our upgraded model router 🔀  
  
Frontier quality at 90% lower cost. Because you shouldn’t need a major in models to pick one.  
  
It matches each task to the right model, balancing quality, speed, and cost. If it gets stuck, it changes course.

And the math is pretty nice, too.  
  
Across 20+ common tasks, Auto delivered results similar to Opus 5.5 and Astra at about 90% lower average cost.  
  
Your credits go about 10× further.

Plus: bring the AI you already pay for.  
  
Connect your ChatGPT Plus, Pro, or Go plan to your personal Notion Agent.  
  
Or Bring Your Own Key (now in private alpha for Ent). [...] Coming soon: AI Command Center.  
  
See usage by person, feature, and agent. Set spending limits and alerts. Decide which models and agents your team can use.  
  
So you’ll always know what’s running, who owns what, and what everything costs.

Notion MCP is our fastest-growing product ever. We took the hint.  
  
We overhauled it so your favorite agents can use Notion as a shared brain: find context, remember what matters, and make things you can share.  
  
Memory sync is live today, with skills via MCP coming soon.

A new credit system for Notion AI.  
  
Your agents can do more now, and increasingly Notion Agent, Custom Agents, and many outside AI tools can all work in one place.  
  
So, now we’re bringing together all AI usage under a new credit system.

results.title: Agents, rebuilt to do more for less.
results.content:
A smarter model router. We’ve upgraded `Auto`, which sends each task to the model that best balances quality, speed, and cost—delivering similar results to frontier models at about 90% lower cost.
 Agents, rebuilt for efficiency. Notion Agent and Custom Agents now run on new infrastructure that unlocks longer-running tasks. It keeps complex tasks focused and credit-efficient with smarter context management and a harness tuned for fewer wasted steps.
 Bring your own AI. Connect your ChatGPT plans to Notion Agent (available now), bring your own model key on Enterprise (private alpha), or connect your AI tools through the improved Notion MCP. [...] AI is moving faster than ever. We added seven new models with our partners at Anthropic, OpenAI, and open-weight providers in the past month alone. Notion Agents can now work on a single task for more than 24 hours, up from five minutes. And your agents can connect to hundreds of different tools via MCPs and connectors, up from a few dozen earlier this summer.

You’ve also made it clear that you’re increasingly using Notion as the infrastructure for your own agents. Our job is to offer you the best model-agnostic context layer to use with any model from any model provider.

So today we’re announcing a set of improvements that make Notion AI more powerful, more reliable, and more efficient—and a new credit system built around them. [...] The result is agents that finish more of what they start (our infra uptime is now >99.9%) and Custom Agent runs that cost about 30% less in testing.

## Use AI you already pay for

You shouldn’t have to pay for AI twice. So there are a few ways to use the AI you already have with Notion.

First, you can now use your ChatGPT subscription. In close partnership with OpenAI, we built a connection that allows you to use your ChatGPT Plus, Pro, or Go accounts inside Notion. It works in your personal Notion Agent to start, not Custom Agents, with more plans and surfaces to follow.
